summary: A six-sample exact-structure AQCat25 prediction batch for held-out R1-F2 was prepared and hash-validated locally against the completed VASP labels and the unchanged MZ73 checkpoint; no files were transferred and no GPU job was submitted.

No AQCat25 force errors, calibration verdict, TS validity, or barrier result exists yet.
payload.one_executable_step: Review the prepared R1-F2 exact-structure prediction batch; upload and MZ73 execution require separate explicit user authorization.

A hash-bound calibration review decides whether this checkpoint is reusable for the in-scope C*+H*->CH* path neighborhood.
Only after calibration may the strategy engine select the least-cost VASP NEB/CI-NEB/DIMER continuation.
